body:
STATE OF ALASKA

Department of Health

Division of Public Assistance

TRANSMITTAL NUMBER: 2026-02

MANUAL: Heating Assistance Program

DATE: September 1, 2026

Several sections of the Heating Assistance Program Policy Manual have been revised in order to incorporate new policy, clarify existing policy, and align policies within our division's policy manuals.

If you have questions, please contact the Policy & Program Development Team at hss.dpa.policy@alaska.gov.

OVERVIEW OF CHANGES

MS 3000 INTRODUCTION AND DEFINITIONS

Updated Introduction to include the Alaska Affordable Heating Program (AAHP) as a funded program administered under HAP.

Updated Introduction to clarify that HAP may issue a one-time direct payment when heat is included in required homeowners association or condominium association dues..

MS 3000-2 DEFINITIONS

Revised the definition and notes for categorical eligibility to align with HAP MS 3001-4H. Clarified categorically eligible households are processed using information displayed in EIS, but only countable income may be used when determining the benefit amount . Alaska Temporary Assistance Program

MS 3001-2 THE APPLICATION FORM

Updated complete application requirements to align with revised verification policy, clarified acceptable rental and identity verification.

Clarified case action procedures for tribal referrals returned to DPA.

MS 3001-4 VERIFICATIONS

Clarified verification requirements for households that otherwise meet eligibility criteria and when reliable, previously verified information or a client statement may be used in making an eligibility determination.

Clarified that households must provide a physical residence address or, if none exists, directions to the residence.

Clarified acceptable verification for heat, rent, and utility costs, including situations where heat or electricity is included in rent, dues, or other verified housing payments.

Clarified that categorically eligible households are processed using information displayed in EIS and are not subject to the full interface verification process. The revision also clarifies that only countable income may be used when determining the benefit amount.

MS 3001-5 ACTIONS TAKEN ON THE APPLICATION

Clarified when the Energy Bill Credit Exceeds Maximum Allowed denial reason applies and added direction for electric account credits that affect a requested 50/50 split but do not make the household ineligible.

Revised the Household Already Received Benefit section to clarify the one-benefit-per-season policy and when a household or household member is considered previously served.

Updated the Over Income denial reasons to reflect the AAHP income limit of 225 percent of FPL.

Added subsection explaining when an application may be reopened and identified reopening as an application action.

MS 3002-1 TYPES OF HOUSEHOLDS

Clarified categorical eligibility processing requirements to align with HAP MS 3001-4H, including use of EIS information, countable income for benefit calculation, and treatment of mixed households or other assistance types.

Updated the income eligibility requirement to reflect the AAHP income limit of 225 percent of FPL.

Clarified acceptable identity verification sources, including but not limited to existing records and DPA-approved systems.

MS 3003-2 NONCOUNTABLE (EXEMPT) INCOME

Clarified that the ANCSA income exemption is not subject to the $2,000 cap for HAP

MS 3003-4 INCOME FROM SELF-EMPLOYMENT

Updated the self-employment annualization standards effective October 1, 2026, to include AAHP income limit of 225 percent of FPL, and clarified rounding procedures for monthly and annualized income amounts.

MS 3003-6 GUIDELINES FOR COMPUTING INCOME

Reorganized into subsections, removed unsupported income rounding language, and clarified that HAP uses actual gross countable income unless a specific alternative calculation method applies .

MS 3004-5 GRANT COMPUTATION

Removed mobile homes from the factor for boats with heated living space less than 980 square feet to correct the applicable dwelling factor.

Added the AAHP income range and corresponding heating cost point percentages for households with income above the LIHEAP limit.

Updated heating assistance season reference from FY2026 to FY2027 to align with the current heating assistance season.

Updated fiscal year reference FY 2026 reference to FY 2027 and added AAHP price-per-point rate.

MS 3008-1 TIME FRAMES FOR ASSISTANCE

Clarified application processing order, payment run schedules, holiday payment run procedures, vendor notice methods, and vendor responsibility for applying payments to client accounts.

MS 3008-3 DISTRIBUTION OF GRANT BETWEEN HEATING AND ELECTRICITY

Clarified that an electric account credit covering approximately 12 months of expenses may prevent issuance of the electric portion of a requested 50/50 split; if the household remains eligible, 100% of the grant must be issued to the primary heating vendor.

MS 3008-4 METHODS OF PAYMENT

Clarified that a one-time direct payment may be issued when a household pays home heating and/or electricity costs indirectly through required homeowners association or condominium association dues.

Addendum A COMMUNITY LISTING

Updated the fiscal year reference to FFY2027.

Added natural gas points for North Pole.

Addendum B HAP TRIBAL PROVIDERS

Updated the fiscal year reference to FFY2027.

Updated Orutsaramiut Native Council’s contact from Mary Simon to Peter Evon.

Corrected APIA’s contact information.

Updated Kenaitze Tribe of Alaska’s contact information.

Updated Sitka Tribe of Alaska’s contact information.

Updated TCC’s contact information.

Updated Aniak Tribal Council’s information

Addendum E AK FEDERAL POVERTY INCOME GUIDELINES

Updated the Federal Poverty Income Guidelines for FFY2027 and added the AAHP income limits.

STATE OF ALASKA

Department of Health and Social Services

Division of Public Assistance

TRANSMITTAL NUMBER: 2020-01

MANUAL: Heating Assistance Program

DATE: September 1, 2020

Several sections of the Heating Assistance Program Policy Manual have been revised in order to incorporate new policy, clarify existing policy, and align policies within our policy manuals.

If you have questions, please contact the Policy and Program Development Team at dpapolicy@alaska.gov .

OVERVIEW OF CHANGES

MS 3000-1 (B) RECORDS AND REPORTS

Rewrote section to better align with other DPA Division of Public Assistance programs

MS 3000-1 (C) NONDISCRIMINATION

Rewrote section to better align with other DPA Division of Public Assistance programs

MS 3000-1 (E) DISCLOSURE AND USE OF INFORMATION

Rewrote section to better align with other DPA Division of Public Assistance programs

MS 3000-1 (F) VOLUNTEERS

Rewrote section to better align with other DPA Division of Public Assistance programs

MS 3000-1 (G) QUALITY ASSESSMENT REVIEWS

Rewrote section to better align with other DPA Division of Public Assistance programs

MS 3000-1 (I) PRUDENT PERSON JUDGEMENT (PPJ)

Rewrote section to better align with other DPA Division of Public Assistance programs

MS 3000-1 (J) PROCESSING APPLICATIONS OF STAFF, FRIENDS, OR RELATIVES

Removed section as this subject is addressed in Alaska Administrative Procedures Manual section 100-10 C 2

MS 3000-2 DEFINITIONS

Revised definition of fee agents by removing the link to current fee agents as this is not available to the public

Revised definition of gross monthly income to clarify that the month prior to receipt of the application is used

Revised definition of shelter costs by removing the heating source limitations as these are no longer applicable

Revised definition of supplemental benefit to clarify that issuance of supplemental benefits when the State has received contingency funding or has unspent funds remaining from the block grant are not guaranteed

MS 3001 APPLICATION PROCESS

Removed hyperlink to current fee agents as it is not available to the public

MS 3001-1 APPLICATION FORM AVAILABILITY

Removed online application submission option as this is not currently available

Removed reference to specific application page numbers since the HAP Heating Assistance Program application content has changed

MS 3001-2 (A) WHAT IS AN IDENTIFIABLE APPLICATION FORM?

Rewrote section to better align with other DPA Division of Public Assistance programs

MS 3001-2 (F) COMPLETE APPLICATION

Generalized the need for proof of ID by removing specific reference to head of household

MS 3001-2 (G) SUBMITTING THE APPLICATION

Removed section as this subject is covered in the Alaska Administrative Procedures Manual

The section was renumbered and renamed to 3001-2 G Tribal Applications

MS 3001-2 (H) DUPLICATE APPLICATIONS

Removed section as it is located in the ECOS Energy Community Online System How To User Guide

The section was renumbered and renamed to 3001-2 H Voter Registration Applications

MS 3001-2 (I) TRIBAL APPLICATIONS

Removed reference to inputting an alert as this procedure is no longer applicable

This section was renumbered to 3001-2 G

MS 3001-2 (J) APPLICATIONS NOT TIMELY/LATE APPLICATIONS

Removed section since now that HAP Heating Assistance Program runs 12 months a year there is no submission date requirement

MS 3001-4 VERIFICATIONS

Removed reference to HAP Heating Assistance Program 's retired database ( HAS Heating Assistance Software )

MS 3001-4(A) VERIFICATION REQUIREMENTS FOR INITIAL APPLICATIONS

Removed screen shots of HAP's retired database ( HAS Heating Assistance Software )

MS 3001-4 (E) HOUSEHOLD COMPOSITION

Removed reference to old policy where the signature date of the application was a factor of eligibility and replace with new policy referencing application received in DPA Division of Public Assistance office as a factor of eligibility

MS 3001-4 (F) INCOME

Removed reference to old policy where the signature date of the application was a factor eligibility and replaced with new policy referencing application received in DPA Division of Public Assistance office as a factor of eligibility

MS 3001-5 (C) EXPEDITE PROCESSING OF THE APPLICATION

Removed seasonal references as HAP Heating Assistance Program now runs 12 months a year

Removed the heating source limitations referenced in HAP Heating Assistance Program 's shelter costs as these are no longer applicable

MS 3001-5 (E) PENDING THE APPLICATION

Removed the direction to re-pend when only partial requested verification is received to align with DPA Division of Public Assistance 's other program policies

Removed reference to old policy where the signature date on the application was a factor of eligibility

Removed requirement for self-employment documentation as verbal statement from the client is now considered acceptable to align with DPA Division of Public Assistance 's other program policies

Removed "elderly or disabled" as a reason to re-pend an application as this client base is covered under re-pend reason "extenuating circumstances"

MS 3001-5 (F) DENYING THE APPLICATION

Removed the requirement to submit a complete application to the HAP Heating Assistance Program office as all DPA Division of Public Assistance Field Offices will now accept HAP Heating Assistance Program applications

Rewrote section to better align with other DPA Division of Public Assistance programs

MS 3002-1 (E) SOCIAL SECURITY NUMBERS

Revised to only require verification of SSN Social Security Number when questionable to align with DPA Division of Public Assistance 's other program policies

MS 3003 INCOME

Added reference to how income is countable in the month prior to receipt of an application. This provides for better understanding of the new policy change of using the application receipt date instead of the signature date

MS 3003-1 (A) EARNED INCOME

Added the option to use written or verbal verification of self-employment income to align with DPA Division of Public Assistance 's other program policies

MS 3003-3 (C) BUDGET

Removed duplicate reference to Threshold Test

MS 3003-4 INCOME FROM SELF-EMPLOYMENT

Removed note referencing requirement for hard copy documentation of self-employment verification as this requirement is no longer applicable

MS 3003-4 (C) VERIFICATION OF SELF-EMPLOYMENT INCOME AND EXPENSES

Rewrote section to better align with other DPA Division of Public Assistance programs

MS 3003-4 (E) THRESHOLD TEST

Changed reference of "threshold test" to "annualization standard" to keep policy terminology consistent between DPA Division of Public Assistance programs

Renamed section to Self-Employment Annualization Standard

Updated reference from FY2020 to FY2021

MS 3003-6 GUIDELINES FOR COMPUTING INCOME

Added reference to how income is countable in the month prior to receipt of an application. This provides for better understanding of the new policy change of using the application receipt date instead of the signature date.

To avoid confusion, reiterated HAP Heating Assistance Program does not prospect future income like the other DPA Division of Public Assistance programs

MS 3004-1 (A) ORDER RECEIVED

Deleted section referencing how applications are processed as procedural content should be addressed in the HowWe Guide

MS 3004-1 (B) ONE AWARD PER SEASON

Due to section deletion, 3004-1B One Award Per Season has been renumbered to 3004-1A

Changed seasonal reference from September 1 - April 30 to September 1 - August 31

MS 3004-1 (C) PROCESSING TIME FRAMES

Due to section deletion, 3004-1C Processing Time Frames has been renumbered to 3004-1B

Removed the requirement to submit a complete application to the HAP Heating Assistance Program office as all DPA Division of Public Assistance Field Offices will now accept HAP Heating Assistance Program applications

MS 3004-5 GRANT COMPUTATION

Updated Fiscal Year to FY2021

Changed rate from $140 to $165 per point

MS 3005-1 (A) CRITERIA FOR EXPEDITED PROCESSING

Removed the heating source limitations referenced in HAP Heating Assistance Program 's shelter costs as these are no longer applicable

MS 3005-1 (B) EXPEDITED TIME FRAMES

Updated expedited eligibility service from November 1 - April 30 to September 1 - August 31

Added note to clarify that the issuance of expedited payments start November 1

MS 3008-1 TIME FRAMES FOR ASSISTANCE PAYMENTS

Extended payment award dates from November 1 - April 30 to November 1 - August 31 as HAP Heating Assistance Program is now being processed 12 months out of the year

MS 3010 PERFORMANCE MEASURES

Deleted section. Performance Measures are not used by field staff to determine eligibility

STATE OF ALASKA

Department of Health and Social Services

Division of Public Assistance

TRANSMITTAL NUMBER: 2021-01

MANUAL: Heating Assistance Program

DATE: April 1, 2021

Several sections of the Heating Assistance Program Policy Manual have been revised in order to incorporate new policy, clarify existing policy, and align policies within our policy manuals.

If you have questions, please contact the Policy and Program Development Team at dpapolicy@alaska.gov .

OVERVIEW OF CHANGES

MS 3000-1 RESPONSIBILITIES IN ADMINISTRATION

Replaced "HAP Coordinator" with dpapolicy@alaska.gov throughout the section.

MS 3000-2 DEFINITIONS

Added the definition of a "bedroom" to clarify when a room in a residence is considered a bedroom.

Added the definition of a "signature" to clarify what DPA Division of Public Assistance considers to be an acceptable signature.

Updated the definition of "Temporary Assistance for Needy Families" to include "cash" as a type of assistance provided by the program and removed reference to diversion payments as this type of payment has been obsolete in the State of Alaska since 2011.

MS 3001-1 APPLICATION FORM AVAILABILITY

Removed old HAP Heating Assistance Program phone number, clients and vendors can now call any DPA Division of Public Assistance office for HAP Heating Assistance Program assistance.

Removed disabled LIHEAP Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program specific email address, liheap@alaska.gov and replaced with statewide email address, hss.dpa.offices@alaska.gov .

MS 3001-2 THE APPLICATION FORM

Replaced "HAP Coordinator" with dpapolicy@alaska.gov throughout the section.

Inserted new subsection "Taking Application by Phone" and renumbered/relettered subsections accordingly.

MS 3002-1 A TYPES OF HOUSEHOLDS

Added subsection describing how to handle a situation where the household composition on the HAP Heating Assistance Program application is different than on other open DPA Division of Public Assistance cases.

MS 3003-2 NONCOUNTABLE (EXEMPT) INCOME

Added subsection title 3003-2 A . NONCOUNTABLE (EXEMPT) INCOME to keep formatting consistent throughout the manual.

Added children's ATAP Alaska Temporary Assistance Program income as noncountable in a shared custody situation when the parents receiving the ATAP Alaska Temporary Assistance Program payment on behalf of the child(ren) are not in the HAP Heating Assistance Program household.

Added 2020 Census income as noncountable income.

MS 3008-2 USE OF HAP Heating Assistance Program PAYMENTS

Replaced "snow machine" with "snowmobile" and "automobile" with "vehicle" throughout the section and added ATV All Terrain Vehicle s to align with DPA Division of Public Assistance manuals.

Replaced "HAP Coordinator" with dpapolicy@alaska.gov throughout the section.

MS 3008-3 DISTRIBUTION OF GRANT BETWEEN HEATING AND ELECTRICITY

Added subsection identifying the 75% heat / 25% electric benefit split option.

Added subsection outlining how the grant can be distributed when an electric account is disconnected and preventing us of the client's primary fuel source.

MS 3008-4 METHODS OF PAYMENT

Changed the term "oil' to "fuel" to encompass all qualifying fuel types.

Removed reference to the Direct Pay Log as it has not been used since FY2018.

Clarified that the processing caseworker must contact dpapolicy@alaska.gov when it appears there are zero heating vendors in a client's area of residence, and await a response before issuing a direct payment to the client.

Added direct pay as an option for client's who live in their vehicle and require gasoline to heat their home, since the Approved Vendors Listing does not include gasoline vendors.

Clarified that justification for a direct payment must be written in the client's case note.

Replaced "HAP Coordinator" with dpapolicy@alaska.gov throughout the section.

MS 3008-5 BAD DEBT

Added exception allowing outstanding heating fuel and/or electric bills to be paid prior to the end of the season if the benefit is being used to prevent a disconnect of service or to reconnect service to the household.

STATE OF ALASKA

Department of Health and Social Services

Division of Public Assistance

TRANSMITTAL NUMBER: 2021-02

MANUAL: Heating Assistance Program

DATE: September 1, 2021

Several sections of the Heating Assistance Program Policy Manual have been revised in order to incorporate new policy, clarify existing policy, and align policies within our policy manuals.

If you have questions, please contact the Policy and Program Development Team at dpapolicy@alaska.gov .

OVERVIEW OF CHANGES

MS 3000 INTRODUCTIONS AND DEFINITIONS

Added direct pay as allowable for clients who self-harvest or purchase wood as their primary heat source.

MS 3000-1B RECORDS AND REPORTS

Updated location of client records from the case file to ILINX.

MS 3000-1E DISCLOSURE AND USE OF INFORMATION

Added weatherization services as an agency DPA Division of Public Assistance obtains information from and discloses information to.

MS 3000-2 DEFINITIONS

Made known that the Head of Household is commonly referred to as the Primary Information Person (PI) and is the first person listed on the application.

Removed Alaska Native/American Indian as part of the "Mixed" Household definition. This type of household is now explained in section 3002-1 .

Updated the "Vendor" definition to include an explanation of an "Approved" Vendor" and direction on how a vendor can contact DPA Division of Public Assistance to become an approved vendor.

Corrected SSI Supplemental Security Income definition.

MS 3001-1 APPLICATION FORM AVAILABILITY

Updated the HAP Heating Assistance Program season start-up application mailing dates for the elderly, disabled, families with young children, and all other previous season participants.

MS 3001-2G COMPLETE APPLICATION

Removed reference to the number associated with questions on the application as these may change from year to year when updates to the application are made.

Removed requirement for all adults in the household to sign the application.

MS 3001-2H TRIBAL APPLICATIONS

Replaced reference to "mixed" household with "household containing both Native and non-Native members." This aligns with DPA Division of Public Assistance 's other program manuals.

Removed definition "head of household" since this term is defined in section 3000-2 .

Removed reference to obsolete eligibility system codes.

MS 3001-4A VERIFICATION REQUIREMENTS FOR INITIAL APPLICATIONS

Updated note with explanation of why DPA Division of Public Assistance requires both the fuel and electric billing statements.

MS 3001-4C HEAT OR RENT COST

Removed reference to not needing a copy of the rental agreement for the client's file, as all submitted documentation is now scanned into ILINX.

Changed reference from " HAP Heating Assistance Program staff" to "caseworker" to align with DPA Division of Public Assistance 's other program manuals.

MS 3001-4H INFORMATION FROM DATA SYSTEMS AND EIS Eligibility Information System INTERFACES

Changed section title from "Use of Interface DPA Division of Public Assistance s" to "Information from Data Systems and EIS Eligibility Information System Interfaces" to align with DPA Division of Public Assistance 's other program manuals.

Changed reference from "worker" to "caseworker" to align with DPA Division of Public Assistance 's other program manuals.

Updated section to mirror DPA Division of Public Assistance 's other program manuals.

MS 3001-4J QUESTIONABLE INFORMATION

Changed reference from " ET Eligibility Technician " to "caseworker" to align with DPA Division of Public Assistance 's other program manuals.

MS 3001-5A ENTERING APPLICATIONS

Referred to and provided link to Administrative Procedures Manual, Section 101-7 .

MS 3001-5C EXPEDITE PROCESSING OF THE APPLICATION

Added SRHUD Subsidized Rental Housing Utility Deposit applications to the expedite processing criteria, since mention of expediting this type of application was removed from MS 3001-5A .

MS 3001-5D CHANGES REPORTED TO DPA Division of Public Assistance

Inserted new subsection to address changes reported and additional applications received before a case decision is made, to align with DPA Division of Public Assistance 's other program manuals.

MS 3001-5E APPROVING THE APPLICATION

Renumbered subsection from 3001-5D to 3001-5E to accommodate the insertion of new subsection "Changes Reported to DPA Division of Public Assistance ."

MS 3001-5F PENDING THE APPLICATION

Renumbered the subsection from 3001-5E to 3001-5F to accommodate the insertion of new subsection "Changes Reported to DPA Division of Public Assistance ."

Added reference to submitted documentation being filed electronically in ILINX.

Added incorrect timeframe for the initial pend notice as a reason for re-pending the application.

MS 3001-5G DENYING THE APPLICATION

Renumbered the subsection from 3001-5F to 3001-5G to accommodate the insertion of new subsection "Changes Reported to DPA Division of Public Assistance ."

MS 3001-5H REASONS FOR DENYING AN APPLICATION

Renumbered the subsection from 3001-5G to 3001-5H to accommodate the insertion of new subsection "Changes Reported to DPA Division of Public Assistance ."

Removed reference to obsolete eligibility system codes.

Removed example of wording used in a denial notice for a client living in a temporary shelter. This information should be referenced in a job aid.

Removed example of wording used in a denial notice for a client who is eligible to be served by Tribal LIHEAP Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program . This information should be referenced in a job aid.

Changed reference from "worker" to "caseworker" to align with DPA Division of Public Assistance 's other program manuals.

MS 3002-1A TYPES OF HOUSEHOLDS

Changed reference from "worker" to "caseworker" to align with DPA Division of Public Assistance 's other program manuals.

Changed how benefits are issued to a deceased client's account to align with functionality limitations of ECOS Energy Community Online System .

Removed reference to obsolete eligibility system codes.

Changed reference from "putting" documentation in the client's file to "uploading" it into ILINX.

Added reference to the "mixed" household definition when describing a household in which only a portion of the household members receive public assistance.

Removed reference to the number associated with questions on the application as these may change from year to year when updates to the application are made.

Removed the option for parents to choose who will claim the children in a shared custody situation because children are included in the first application received for the program year.

MS 3002-1C IDENTITY

Changed the reference from a person "making" an application to "listed as head of household" on the application.

Removed requirement for a copy of the head of household's ID Identification to be on file. This section lists out all the acceptable forms of identity verification.

MS 3002-1D CITIZENSHIP AND ELIGIBLE ALIEN STATUS

Removed reference to the number associated with questions on the application as these may change from year to year when updates to the application are made.

Removed reference to "pend application for 30 days when requesting US citizenship verification." The 30 day pend is the standard pend period for all initial HAP Heating Assistance Program pends.

Added the requirement to validate citizenship documentation through IEVS Instant Eligibility Verification System when aliens are listed in the household, to align with DPA Division of Public Assistance 's other program manuals.

MS 3003 INCOME

Moved reference to garnishments to HAP Heating Assistance Program MS 3003-1C Garnishments to align with DPA Division of Public Assistance 's other program manuals.

Moved reference to recoupments to HAP Heating Assistance Program MS 3003-2A Non-Countable (Exempt) Income to align with DPA Division of Public Assistance 's other program manuals.

MS 3003-1B UNEARNED INCOME

Removed recouped UIB Unemployment Insurance Benefits benefits as countable unearned income. This type of income is not countable.

Changed reference from "worker" to "caseworker" to align with DPA Division of Public Assistance 's other program manuals.

MS 3003-1C GARNISHMENTS

Added subsection for garnishments to align with DPA Division of Public Assistance 's other program manuals.

MS 3003-2A NON-COUNTABLE (EXEMPT) INCOME

Added October 31, 2021 expiration date to the exemption of the 2020 Census income, to align with DPA Division of Public Assistance 's other program manuals.

Added recoupments as a type of non-countable income to align with DPA Division of Public Assistance 's other program manuals and renumbered section to accommodate added noncountable income category.

Changed reference from "worker" to "caseworker" to align with DPA Division of Public Assistance 's other program manuals.

Added major disaster and emergency assistance as non-countable income, to align with DPA Division of Public Assistance 's other program manuals.

MS 3003-3 SEASONAL EMPLOYMENT

Replaced reference to obsolete DOL Department of Labor screen with reference to current DOL Department of Labor / SAM Secure Access Manager screen.

MS 3003-4E SELF-EMPLOYMENT ANNUALIZATION STANDARD

Updated self-employment annualization standards.

Changed reference from 'worker" to "caseworker" to align with DPA Division of Public Assistance 's other program manuals.

MS 3003-6 GUIDELINES FOR COMPUTING INCOME

Removed reference to obsolete system codes.

MS 3004-1 ELIGIBILITY DETERMINATION TIME FRAMES

Updated HAP Heating Assistance Program season start and end dates from September 1 - August 31 to October 1 - September 30.

Removed "as soon as possible" from the processing time frames guidelines. Required processing time frames remain outlined within the section.

MS 3004-2 ASSISTANCE CATEGORIES

Removed reference to obsolete eligibility system.

MS 3004-3 DWELLING TYPE AND FACTOR

Added duplex and triplex units to the two-bedroom single family home dwelling type.

MS 3004-5 GRANT COMPUTATION

Removed reference to the division when explaining how to calculate the HAP Heating Assistance Program grant.

Added duplex and triplex units to the two-bedroom single family home dwelling type.

Named the heating assistance software ( ECOS Energy Community Online System ) referenced in this section.

Updated FY Fiscal Year 2021 to FY Fiscal Year 2022.

Updated the income and price per point for FY Fiscal Year 2022 referenced in the examples.

MS 3005-1A CRITERIA FOR EXPEDITED PROCESSING

Added exception requiring the caseworker to attempt to obtain verification of disconnect through the vendor if disconnect notice is not provided with application.

MS 3005-1B EXPEDITED TIMEFRAMES

Updated HAP Heating Assistance Program season start and end dates from September 1 - August 31 to October 1 - September 30.

Removed reference to the first payment issuance date of November 1 as there will no longer be a payment delay at the beginning of the season.

MS 3005-2 EXPEDITED PROCESSING FOR HOUSEHOLD WITH ELDERLY OR DISABLED MEMBERS

Changed reference from " HAP Heating Assistance Program worker" to "caseworker" to align with DPA Division of Public Assistance 's other program manuals.

Added caveat removing the expedite entitlement in future years if a client fails to provide requested information that was temporarily waived in order to resolve an emergency situation. This aligns with the SNAP Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program manual.

MS 3007 SPECIALIZED PROCEDURES

Removed the introductory statement since it described standard procedure for all public assistance case types.

MS 3007-1 ECOS Energy Community Online System ALERT CODES - THIS SECTION WILL BE UPDATED ONCE ECOS Energy Community Online System IS FULLY FUNCTIONAL

Removed section. ECOS Energy Community Online System does not issue alert codes.

Renumbered subsequent subsections.

MS 3007-1 SUBSIDIZED HEAT AND APPLICATION PROCESSING

Changed reference from "worker" to "caseworker" to align with DPA Division of Public Assistance 's other program manuals.

Removed reference to obsolete system codes.

Converted subsections to bullets. Subsections became significantly shorter after removing the obsolete system code references.

MS 3007-2A MUTUAL HELP

Changed reference from "worker" to "caseworker" to align with DPA Division of Public Assistance 's other program manuals.

MS 3007-2B LOW INCOME TAX CREDIT PROGRAMS (LITC)

Changed reference from "worker" to caseworker" to align with DPA Division of Public Assistance 's other program manuals.

MS 3007-4 OTHER UNIQUE SITUATIONS

Removed subsection as all situations are discussed in HAP Heating Assistance Program MS Manual Section 3002-1A .

MS 3008-1 TIMEFRAMES FOR ASSISTANCE PAYMENTS

Updated timeframe and payment information from November 1 - August 31 to October 1 - September 30.

Removed reference to issuing payments prior to the program start date for disaster proclamations. The new HAP Heating Assistance Program season is now a year long program.

Removed reference to SRHUD Subsidized Rental Housing Utility Deposit s being payable throughout the year. The new HAP Heating Assistance Program season is now a year long program.

MS 3008-2A HEATING ASSISTANCE PAYMENTS CAN ONLY BE USED FOR THE PURCHASE OF:

Changed "oil" to "fuel" as oil is not the only fuel type used for home heating.

Removed requirement for the vendor notice to spell out what can be purchased with a grant issued for a client who self-harvests wood. These clients will be issued a direct payment.

MS 3008-2B HEATING ASSISTANCE PAYMENTS CANNOT BE USED FOR:

Changed "oil" to "fuel" as oil is not the only fuel type used for home heating.

MS 3008-3A DISTRIBUTION OF GRANT BETWEEN HEATING AND ELECTRICITY

Removed redundant sentence regarding the 75/25 benefit split option.

MS 3008-4A VENDOR PAYMENT

Removed reference to obsolete system codes.

Changed reference from "worker" to "caseworker" to align with DPA Division of Public Assistance 's other program manuals.

Removed note regarding issuing a direct payment for the first year when the client uses a non-approved vendor. New policy requires the caseworker to notify dpapolicy@alaska.gov and await further instruction when this situation arises.

Removed note referring to the Direct Payment log. This log is no longer in use.

Removed reference to "Two-Party Payment." This payment type is no longer an option.

MS 3008-6 GRANT TRANSFER

Changed reference from "furnace" to "heating system" as a furnace is not the only type of heating system used to heat a home.

Changed references of "supervisor" to "sending an email to dpapolicy@alaska.gov " when determining when a grant may be transferred from one vendor to another.

MS 3009 FAIR HEARINGS

Removed the detailed fair hearing process and provided link to Administrative Procedures Manual Section 117 , to align with DPA Division of Public Assistance 's other program manuals.

MS 3011 FRAUD

Replaced current content with policy written in DPA Division of Public Assistance 's other program manuals.

MS 3012 PROGRAM ADMINISTRATION AND CO STS

Updated administrative and direct program costs table.

Addendum B HAP Heating Assistance Program TRIBAL PROVIDERS

Changed FY Fiscal Year 2020 to FFY Federal Fiscal Year 2022.

Addendum E FEDERAL POVERTY INCOME GUIDELINES

Changed FFY Federal Fiscal Year 2021 to FFY Federal Fiscal Year 2022.

Updated HAP Heating Assistance Program season start and end dates from September 1 - August 31 to October 1 - September 30.

Updated FPL Federal Poverty Level income guidelines.

Addendum F HOUSING AUTHORITY CONTACT INFORMATION

Updated housing authority contact information.

TRANSMITTAL NUMBER: 2021-03

MANUAL: Heating Assistance Program

DATE: December 1, 2021

Several sections of the Heating Assistance Program Policy Manual have been revised in order to incorporate new policy, clarify existing policy, and align policies within our policy manuals.

If you have questions, please contact the Policy & Program Development Team at dpapolicy@alaska.gov .

OVERVIEW OF CHANGES

MS 3001 APPLICATION PROCESS

Updated application process to allow for applications to be completed and signed via telephonic recording to align with DPA Division of Public Assistance 's other policy manuals.

MS 3001-1 APPLICATION FORM AVAILABILITY

Added telephonic application as a method of form availability.

MS 3001-2F TAKING AN APPLICATION BY PHONE

Removed subsection as this action is no longer limited to the elderly or disabled, and is now addressed in MS 3001 .

MS 3005-2 EXPEDITED PROCESSING FOR HOUSEHOLDS WITH ELDERLY OR DISABLED MEMBERS

Removed reference to the exception for telephonic applications and signature requirements for the elderly or disabled as all clients are now allowed to complete and sign an application via telephonic recording. This process is now referenced in manual section 3001 .

STATE OF ALASKA

Department of Health and Social Services

Division of Public Assistance

TRANSMITTAL NUMBER: 2022-01

MANUAL: Heating Assistance Program

DATE: April 1, 2022

Several sections of the Heating Assistance Program Policy Manual have been revised in order to incorporate new policy, clarify existing policy, and align policies within our division's policy manuals.

If you have questions, please contact the Policy & Program Development Team at hss.dpa.policy@alaska.gov.

OVERVIEW OF CHANGES

MS 3001-4 VERIFICATION

Clarified that SOLQ cannot be used to determine eligibility for HAP Heating Assistance Program .

Clarified that SVES must always be checked at application and recertification, and death match alerts that are generated during the certification period must be processed within 10 days.

MS 3001-5 ACTIONS TAKEN ON THE APPLICATION

Clarified that re-pends (additional requests for information) have a 15 day pend period.

Removed outdated reference in regards to pending the application to verify a wood vendor.

Clarified that verification of identity notated in EIS Eligibility Information System meets the "Proof of ID" requirement.

Clarified that a request to withdraw a HAP Heating Assistance Program application must be made in writing.

MS 3002-1 TYPES OF HOUSEHOLDS

Updated how benefits are paid on behalf of the deceased, from issuing only what is owed on the client's accounts to issuing the full benefit and requesting the vendor return any credit on the account after the client's debt has been paid. This change is due to ECOS' payment limitations.

MS 3003-1 COUNTABLE INCOME

Added "severance pay" to the wages definition, as it is included in the wages definition in Addendum G.

MS 3008-4 METHODS OF PAYMENT

Removed requirement for a caseworker to confirm with policy that there are zero HAP Heating Assistance Program vendors in a client's service area before issuing a direct payment for purchasing wood. This aligns with policy established in the News Flash dated 03/03/2021.

STATE OF ALASKA

Department of Health

Division of Public Assistance

TRANSMITTAL NUMBER: 2022-03

MANUAL: Heating Assistance Program

DATE: December 1, 2022

Several sections of the Heating Assistance Program Policy Manual have been revised in order to incorporate new policy, clarify existing policy, and align policies within our division's policy manuals.

If you have questions, please contact the Policy & Program Development Team at hss.dpa.policy@alaska.gov.

OVERVIEW OF CHANGES

ENTIRE MANUAL

Changed all references from DHSS Department of Health and Social Services to DOH Department of Health , including any email addresses and websites.

MS 3000-2 DEFINITIONS

Added link to Home Heating Costs definition, directing caseworkers to MS Manual Section 3001-4C.

Added the term "Certificate of Medical Necessity (CMN)" and included HAP Heating Assistance Program 's definition, to align with the HAP Heating Assistance Program State Plan.

Updated the definition for "Crisis" to align with the HAP Heating Assistance Program State Plan.

Updated the definition for "Home Heating Costs" to align with the HAP Heating Assistance Program State Plan.

Updated the definition for "Life Threatening Crisis" to align with the HAP Heating Assistance Program State Plan.

Added the term "Medically Necessary" and included HAP Heating Assistance Program 's definition, to align with the HAP Heating Assistance Program State Plan.

Added link to Expedite definition, directing caseworkers to MS Manual Section 3005.

MS 3001-2G TRIBAL APPLICATIONS

Added note clarifying clients who meet the criteria to be served by a tribal organization do not gain eligibility to be served by DPA Division of Public Assistance due to the start or end dates of a tribal organization's LIHEAP Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program season.

MS 3001-4H INFORMATION FROM DATA SYSTEMS AND EIS INTERFACES

Clarified IEVS Instant Eligibility Verification System is used to check PFD Permanent Fund Dividend and Quarterly Wage.

Added SVES to Interface table and explained it is used to verify date of death and SSA Social Security Administration and SSI Supplemental Security Income Payments.

Clarified IEVS is used to check qualified alien status of household members who are not U.S. Citizens.

Removed reference to NFIN, the acronym for the database NSTAR Northern Support through Automated Resources , as this is a system DPA Division of Public Assistance no longer uses.

MS 3001-5H REASONS FOR DENYING THE APPLICATION

Removed reference to obsolete eligibility codes.

Updated list of denial reasons to match the denial reasons listed in ECOS Energy Community Online System .

MS 3002-1A TYPES OF HOUSEHOLDS

Added note clarifying clients who meet the criteria to be served by a tribal organization do not gain eligibility to be served by DPA Division of Public Assistance due to the start or end dates of a tribal organization's LIHEAP Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program season.

Corrected formula for Housing Percent Share from total "cost points" to "grant amount."

MS 3003-4E SELF-EMPLOYMENT ANNUALIZATION STANDARDS

Revised the self-employment annualization standards that changed effective October 1, 2022 (this was missed in the 09/22 manual change.)

Clarified how to apply the annualization standard and provided examples.

MS 3004-4 FUEL TYPE

Added gasoline as a fuel type and added a note clarifying when gasoline is an allowable fuel type.

MS 3004-5 GRANT COMPUTATION

Added instruction to use the community fuel points for oil when clients primary fuel type is gasoline.

Updated FFY Federal Fiscal Year 2022 to FFY Federal Fiscal Year 2023.

MS 3005-1 EXPEDITED APPLICATIONS

Updated expedited service to include households with an elderly or disabled individual and children under 6 years of age, to align with the HAP Heating Assistance Program State Plan.

MS 3005-1A EXPEDITE CRITERIA

Added "Crisis" and "Life Threatening Crisis" as expedite criteria to align with the HAP Heating Assistance Program State Plan.

Removed income test criteria to align with the HAP Heating Assistance Program State Plan.

MS 3007-1 SUBSIDIZED HEAT

Replaced reference to Section 8 (Choice) voucher and AHFC Alaska Housing Finance Corporation with the geric term "subsidized housing" as to not exclude any subsidized housing entities.

MS 3008-3 DISTRIBUTION OF GRANT

Added note explaining the HAP Heating Assistance Program grant can only be split between the primary heat source and electric. Additional/back-up heat sources are not eligible to receive a portion of the grant.

MS 3008-6A THE GRANT TRANSFER PROCESS

Added subsection titled "The Grant Transfer Process." Content outlines the caseworker, Policy and Program Development, and Administrative steps required to complete a grant transfer that adheres to policy requirements for HAP Heating Assistance Program .

MS 3010 PERFORMANCE MEASURES

Changed section title from "Reserved" to "Performance Measures."

Added introduction to HAP Heating Assistance Program Performance Measures to alleviate staff confusion regarding program requirements to collect information.

Addendum A HAP COMMUNITY LISTING

Added all military bases in Alaska to community listing.

Addendum B HAP TRIBAL PROVIDERS

Updated tribal provider contact information.

Addendum F HOUSING AUTHORITY CONTACT INFORMATION

Updated housing authority contact information.

STATE OF ALASKA

Department of Health

Division of Public Assistance

TRANSMITTAL NUMBER: 2023-02

MANUAL: Heating Assistance Program

DATE: September 1, 2023

Several sections of the Heating Assistance Program Policy Manual have been revised in order to incorporate new policy, clarify existing policy, and align policies within our division's policy manuals.

If you have questions, please contact the Policy & Program Development Team at hss.dpa.policy@alaska.gov.

OVERVIEW OF CHANGES

MS 3000 INTRODUCTIONS AND DEFINITIONS

Clarified clients living in non-subsidized housing where heat is included in the rental payment will be issued a direct payment if they are determined eligible for a benefit.

MS 3000-1 E. DISCLOSURES AND USE OF INFORMATION

Clarified that client information can be disclosed to Alaska Housing Finance Corporation.

MS 3000-2 DEFINITIONS

Clarified that a vendor may require a pledge to be submitted in writing.

Removed the definition of "shelter costs" in relation to expedite criteria, as it is no longer used to determine eligibility for expedited processing.

Clarified what expenses are considered to be under the "Home Heating Costs" deduction.

MS 3001-5 C. EXPEDITE PROCESSING OF THE APPLICATION

Removed references to shelter costs as they are no longer a factor of eligibility for expedited processing.

Added "medically necessary" as a factor of eligibility for expedited processing.

MS 3002-1 A. ELIGIBLE HOUSEHOLDS

Clarified how to determine if heat is included in the rental payment.

Clarified how to determine a HAP household.

Clarified how to determine a Boarder/Room Renter.

MS 3003-4 E. SELF-EMPLOYMENT ANNUALIZATION STANDARD

Revised the self-employment annualization standards, based on the January 2023 Federal Register Notice.

MS 3004-5 GRANT COMPUTATION

Clarified that the 50% deduction for living in subsidized housing while receiving a utility allowance is applied to the point count total and not the total benefit amount.

Updated FY2023 to FY2024.

Updated the benefit rate to $175 per point.

MS 3005-1 A. CRITERIA FOR EXPEDITED PROCESSING

Added "medical necessity" as a factor of eligibility for expedited processing.

MS 3005-1 B. EXPEDITED TIME FRAMES

Changed expedited processing time frames in response to Federal audit recommendations.

MS 3007-1 SUBSIDIZED HEAT AND APPLICATION PROCESSING

Clarified that the 50 percent deduction for living in subsidized housing while receiving a utility allowance is applied to the point count total and not the total benefit amount.

MS 3008-1 TIME FRAMES

Changed expedited processing time frames in response to federal audit recommendations.

Added note clarifying how long a client has to use their grant.

MS 3008-4 METHODS OF PAYMENT

Clarified that direct payments are issued to a client when home heating and electric costs are paid indirectly through a current non-subsidized rental payment.

MS 3008-6 GRANT TRANSFERS

Clarified that clients are required to submit copies of their new primary heating fuel and electric billing statements when requesting a grant transfer.

Clarified that clients that move into subsidized housing where heat is included in the rent do not qualify for a grant transfer or direct payment.

Added note clarifying how long a client has to use their grant.

Addendum B HAP TRIBAL PROVIDERS

Updated tribal provider information for FFY Federal Fiscal Year 2024.

Addendum E INCOME GUIDELINES

Updated the Federal Poverty Income Guidelines for FFY Federal Fiscal Year 2024.
heading: Transmittal 2023-02 (09/23)

STATE OF ALASKA

Department of Health

Division of Public Assistance

TRANSMITTAL NUMBER: 2023-03

MANUAL: Heating Assistance Program

DATE: December 1, 2023

Sections of the Heating Assistance Program Policy Manual have been revised in order to incorporate new policy, clarify existing policy, and align policies within our division's policy manuals.

If you have questions, please contact the Policy & Program Development Team at hss.dpa.policy@alaska.gov.

OVERVIEW OF CHANGES

MS 3003-1 B. UNEARNED INCOME

Removed "recoupment" as a countable source of unearned income. Recoupments are exempt income and are addressed in section 3003-2 A.(8) .

MS 3004-1 ELIGIBILITY DETERMINATION TIMEFRAMES

Added the dates of when applications are accepted throughout the season.

MS 3004-5 GRANT COMPUTATION

Changed the subsidized housing deduction from 50% of the client's point count to 50% of the client's total benefit amount and moved the subsidized housing calculation from Step 5 to Step 8. These changes increase eligibility among Alaska's subsidized housing population.

Updated the household income amount in Example 1 so the benefit calculation remains in the 10.1 - 125% of poverty and Example 2 remains in the 125.01 - 150% of poverty category.

Addendum B TRIBAL PROVIDERS

Updated the Kenaitze fax number from 907-335-7239 to 907-202-8359.

Addendum E FEDERAL POVERTY INCOME GUIDELINES

Added "AK" to the title of the addendum to clarify that we use the Alaska Federal Poverty Income Guidelines.

Department of Health

Division of Public Assistance

MANUAL: Heating Assistance Program

DATE: April 1, 2024

Sections of the Heating Assistance Program Policy Manual have been revised in order to incorporate new policy, clarify existing policy, and align policies within our division's policy manuals.

OVERVIEW OF CHANGES

MS 3000-2 DEFINITIONS

Updated the "Identifiable Application" definition to include Tribal energy assistance applications.

MS 3001-2 A. WHAT IS AN IDENTIFIABLE APPLICATION

Clarified that both HAP and Tribal energy assistance applications are considered identifiable and are accepted for DPA Division of Public Assistance eligibility determination.

MS 3001-2 G. TRIBAL APPLICATIONS

Added note clarifying that applications that are registered and auto denied and referred to a tribal agency still need to be filed in ILINX.

Clarified that an application denied as, "Tribal LIHEAP" must be filed in ILINX and a copy of the denied application must be sent to the applicable Tribal LIHEAP Office.

MS 3003-2 A. NON-COUNTABLE (EXEMPT INCOME)

Revised subsection 10. Alaska Native Claims Settlement Act (ANCSA) Income to exempt all ANCSA Alaska Native Claims Settlement Act payments.

body:
STATE OF ALASKA

Department of Health

Division of Public Assistance

TRANSMITTAL NUMBER: 2024-02

MANUAL: Heating Assistance Program

DATE: September 3, 2024

Several sections of the Heating Assistance Program Policy Manual have been revised in order to incorporate new policy, clarify existing policy, and align policies within our division's policy manuals.

If you have questions, please contact the Policy & Program Development Team at hss.dpa.policy@alaska.gov.

OVERVIEW OF CHANGES

MS 3000-2 DEFINITIONS

Added new term, "administrative costs" and provided definition. This is a term ACF Administration for Children and Families requested DPA Division of Public Assistance define.

Clarified households are considered categorically eligible if they receive TANF Temporary Assistance to Needy Families , SNAP Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program , APA Adult Public Assistance , or SSI Supplemental Security Income .

Outlined the period in which clients can be considered categorically eligible.

Added note clarifying that clients who receive only Medicaid, General Relief Assistance, or Senior Benefits are not categorically eligible.

Added note/exception under the definition "categorical eligibility" explaining that actual income information provided with the application may be used instead of the income input into EIS Eligibility Information System if it would be in the client's best interest.

Removed "Certificate of Medical Necessity" definition as this document is no longer required.

Added new term, "completed application" and provided definition.

Added a definition to the term "expedite" instead of only referring to "crisis" and "life-threatening crisis" definitions.

Added new term, "expenditure timeframe" and provided definition. This is a term ACF Administration for Children and Families requested DPA Division of Public Assistance define.

Updated the note under "medically necessary" to allow client statement as acceptable verification.

Added new term, "priority processing" and added link to manual section that defines the term.

Added new term, "older adult" and provided ACF Administration for Children and Families 's definition.

Added new term, "vulnerable population" and added definition.

MS 3001-5C EXPEDITE PROCESSING OF THE APPLICATION

Updated the expedite application acceptance period from January 1 through September 30 to October 1 through September 30.

MS 3002-1 TYPES OF HOUSEHOLDS

Changed reference to the 75/25 split to the 50/50 split.

Clarified households are considered categorically eligible if they receive TANF Temporary Assistance to Needy Families , SNAP Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program , APA Adult Public Assistance , or SSI Supplemental Security Income .

Outlined the period in which clients can be considered categorically eligible.

Added note under "Categorical Households" explaining that actual income information provided with the application may be used instead of the income input into EIS Eligibility Information System if it would be in the client's best interest. Caseworkers should not pend for income information if it is already input into EIS Eligibility Information System .

MS 3002-1 D . CITIZENSHIP AND ELIGIBLE ALIEN STATUS

Added COFA Compact of Free Association migrants as a group eligible for HAP Heating Assistance Program due to a change in law effective March 9, 2024.

MS 3003-1 B. UNEARNED INCOME

Removed reference to Native Dividends as countable income, as they are considered exempt income per 7 AAC 44.042.

MS 3003-4 E. SELF-EMPLOYMENT ANNUALIZATION STANDARDS

Revised the self-employment annualization standards that change effective October 1, 2024.

MS 3003-6 GUIDELINES FOR COMPUTING INCOME

Added exception to the period in which we count income for categorically eligible clients.

MS 3004-1 ELIGIBILITY DETERMINATION TIME FRAMES

Removed the September 1 through April 30 application acceptance dates for elderly and disabled applicants. Applications for all applicants are accepted from October 1 through April 30.

Changed references to "Expedited Heating Assistance" to "Crisis Assistance".

Changed the Crisis Assistance acceptance dates from January 1 through September 30 to October 1 through September 30.

Added priority processing eligibility determination timeframes.

Renumbered "Subsidized Rental Housing Utility Deposit (SRHUD)".

MS 3004-5 GRANT COMPUTATION

Updated FY2024 to FY2025

Added reference to categorically eligibility and clarified the income verification requirement is for non-categorical eligible households.

Removed note stating AHFC Alaska Housing Finance Corporation households should be treated as a regular application with no utility allowance after the first year. These households are still subsidized and are still subject to the subsidized housing adjustment.

MS 3005 EXPEDITED CASES

Changed section title from "Expedited Cases" to "Expedited Applications" because HAP Heating Assistance Program clients are not assigned case numbers.

MS 3005-1 EXPEDITED APPLICATIONS

Renumbered section 3005-1 to 3005.

Renumbered section 3005-1A to 3005-1.

Renumbered section 3005-1B to 3005-2.

Removed elderly, disabled, and children under 6 years of age as qualifying criteria for expediting an application. Applications are only expedited if the client is in crisis or meets medically necessary criteria.

Clarified that client statement is accepted when a client states they have run out of oil, firewood, or coal.

Clarified applicants are required to provide both their primary heating fuel and electric billing statements when requesting expedited processing.

Changed availability of expedited service from January 1 to October 1.

Removed reference to referring clients to community resources if they request expedited service prior to January 1. Expedite service is now available all season.

MS 3005-2 EXPEDITED TIME FRAMES

Clarified that expedited eligibility service is available October 1 through September 30.

MS 3007-2 B. LOW INCOME TAX CREDIT PROGRAMS (LITC)

Updated the term "Low Income Tax Credit" to Low-Income Housing Tax Credit".

Changed the expandable acronym from " T&H Tlingit & Haida " to " THRHA Tlingit and Haida Regional Housing Authority " to distinguish between the Tlingit & Haida Regional Housing Authority (THRHA) and the Central Council for the Tlingit & Haida Indian Tribes of Alaska (CCTHITA or T&H).

MS 3008-1 TIME FRAMES

Updated the expedited acceptance and processing dates.

MS 3008-2 A . HEATING ASSISTANCE PAYMENTS CAN ONLY BE USED FOR THE PURCHASE OF:

Changed grant percentage from 25% to 50% for the purchase of gasoline or propane for households who use a generator to produce their electricity.

Removed "lights" as one of the reasons to allow the purchase of a 30# bottle of propane. Households are now allowed to use 50% of their grant to purchase fuel to produce electricity if they live off-grid.

MS 3008-3 A. THE 75/25 SPLIT OPTION

Changed grant percentage from 75% primary home heating fuel / 25% electric to 50% primary home heating fuel / 50% for electric.

MS 3008-3 B. EXCEPTIONS TO THE 75/25 SPLIT OPTION

Updated the manual section title from "Exceptions to the 75/25 Split" to "Exceptions to the 50/50 Split."

Changed the grant percentage option from 75% primary home heating fuel / 25% electric to 50% primary home heating fuel / 50% for electric.

Removed the requirement for electricity to be the client's primary fuel type in order to receive payment to prevent electric service disconnection or reinstatement.

MS 3008-4 B. DIRECT PAYMENT

Changed email from hss.dpa.policy@alaska.gov to vendors.liheap@alaska.gov.

Clarified that a direct payment can be made to a client if their primary heating fuel or electric account are setup in the landlord's name or the name of an individual who is not a member of the household.

Added note informing staff that ENSTAR will only accept LIHEAP Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program payments issued on behalf of an ENSTAR account holder or their legal spouse and to issue a direct payment to the household if the payment will issue under another household member's name.

MS 3008-4 C. VENDOR PAYMENT AND DIRECT PAYMENT

Changed the 75/25 grant split to 50/50 split.

MS 3008-6 GRANT TRANSFERS

Changed section title from "Grant Transfers" to "Grant Transfers and Refunds" to account for the refund information already presented in the section.

MS 3008-6 A. THE GRANT TRANSFER PROCESS

Changed subsection title from "The Grant Transfer Process" to "The Grant Transfer and Refund Process" to allow for the refund process to be addressed in this subsection.

Changed the grant transfer contact from the Policy Unit to the LIHEAP Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program coordinator.

Changed the contact email address from hss.dpa.policy@alaska.gov to vendors.liheap@alaska.gov

Clarified that the justification for a refund and re-issuance request needs to include the client's new address information, primary heating fuel type, and new vendor account information for both heating fuel and electric.

Clarified that the caseworker informs the client of their payment refund and reissuance status.

ADDENDUM B HAP TRIBAL PROVIDERS

Changed FY2024 to FFY 2025.

ADDENDUM E INCOME GUIDELINES

Updated the Federal Poverty Income Guidelines for FFY2025.
heading: Transmittal 2024-02 (09/24)

THROUGHOUT THE MANUAL

3001-4(H) INFORMATION FROM DATA SOURCES AND EIS INTERFACES

Revised section for clarity

3002-1(B) RESIDENCY

Revised to clarify that alien status documentation must be validated through SAVE Systematic Alien Verification for Entitlements in IEVS Instant Eligibility Verification System

3004-5 GRANT COMPUTATION

Clarified that ECOS Energy Community Online System calculates the points and that any point adjustments noted in the manual are only used for manual calculations

3008-6 GRANT TRANSFERS AND REFUNDS

Clarified that clients are not allowed to change vendors after benefit issuance unless they have moved out of their current vendor's service area, their primary fuel type has changed due to a change in residence, or their primary heating system has become inoperable

Addendum B TRIBAL PROVIDERS

Updated contact information for Tlingit-Haida Regional Housing Authority (THRHA)

OVERVIEW OF CHANGES

MS 3000 INTRODUCTION AND DEFINITIONS

Clarified payments are made to HAP Heating Assistance Program approved vendors.

MS 3000-2 DEFINITIONS

Revised categorically eligible definition for clarity and removed APA Adult Public Assistance as an allowable program.

Updated categorically eligible note to clarify that state funded programs do not qualify for categorical eligibility status.

Updated the crisis definition by removing reference to outdoor temperature and the restriction of only on expedite request per season to align with the LIHEAP Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program Model Plan.

Updated the life-threatening crisis definition by removing the weather restriction and the restriction of only one expedite request per season to align with the LIHEAP Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program Model Plan.

Added definitions for the following terms: deliverable fuel, dwelling, emancipated minor, metered fuel, and minor child.

Added LIHEAP Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program Model Plan definition, as defined in 7 AAC 44.900(16) .

Revised vulnerable population definition for clarity.

MS 3001-4 VERIFICATIONS

Clarified that all applicants must have annual heating costs exceeding $200.

Clarified that approved vendors are not required for wood purchases.

Revised house sitter verification options for clarity.

Removed the option to provide a rent receipt for verification of heat expenses. An applicant is not required to be current on their rental payments in order to receive assistance and the rental receipt does not verify the other factors required to determine eligibility, such as: primary fuel type, type of dwelling, number of bedrooms, etc.

Removed rent receipt from Example 3.

Clarified that applicants living in temporary shelter for more than 60 days must provide verification of an annual heating cost that exceeds $200. Heating costs may include daily shelter fees.

Revised section for clarity replaced "Priority Points" links with a link to HAP MS 3002-1A(13) .

Removed rent receipt requirement in Example 5, to align with updated policy within the section.

MS 3001-5 ACTIONS TAKEN ON THE APPLICATION

Removed reference to "office assistant" since DPA Division of Public Assistance has reclassed this position to a caseworker.

Removed note, stating households can only request expedite service once per season, as there is no limit to the number of applications a person can submit to the program.

Removed "medically necessary" criteria and replaced with "crisis" and "life-threatening crisis."

Clarified that DPA Division of Public Assistance can accept the verbal equivalent of a shut-off notice from a vendor.

Added note clarifying that client statement is acceptable when a client claims to be out of or within 48 hours of being out of deliverable fuel.

Clarified non-life-threatening crisis applications must be processed within 48 hours of DPA Division of Public Assistance receiving a complete application.

Changed the crisis application acceptance period from October 1 through September 30 to October 1 through June 30.

Clarified that address and vendor changes need to be documented and updated in ECOS Energy Community Online System .

MS 3002-1 TYPES OF HOUSEHOLDS

Revised section for clarity.

Corrected house sitter's required heating costs from "at least $200" to "exceeds $200."

Updated "Categorical Households" to "Categorically Eligible Households."

Replaced "income tested" with a list of the actual programs that a household may participate in to be considered Categorically Eligible.

Removed references to ATAP Alaska Temporary Assistance Program as the reference to TANF Temporary Assistance to Needy Families includes ATAP Alaska Temporary Assistance Program .

Clarified how categorical eligibility streamlines the HAP Heating Assistance Program application processing.

Updated categorically eligible note to clarify that state funded programs do not qualify for categorical eligibility status.

Added section regarding vulnerable populations and explained their eligibility priority over other applicants.

MS 3003-4 SELF-EMPLOYMENT ANNUALIZATION STANDARDS

Revised the self-employment annualization standards that change effective October 1, 2025.

MS 3004-1 ELIGIBILITY DETERMINATION TIME FRAMES

Revised section for clarity.

Updated the Crisis Assistance application period from October 1 through September 30 to October 1 through June 30.

Clarified households are limited to one benefit per season from one of the three program components.

Clarified that supplement payments may be issued if the budget allows for it.

Added reference and link to "crisis" definition.

Added reference and link to the "vulnerable populations" definition.

Removed priority processing category "Application Priority Processing" as applications are required to be processed in date order of receipt per 7 AAC 44.030 .

Referenced "vulnerable population" households instead of listing out all of the different types of households that make-up the vulnerable population.

MS 3004-2 ASSISTANCE CATEGORIES

Added Categorical Eligibility as an assistance category tracked in ECOS Energy Community Online System .

MS 3004-5 GRANT COMPUTATION

Referenced "vulnerable population" households instead of listing out all of the different types of households that make-up the vulnerable population.

Updated FY 2025 to FY 2026.

MS 3005-2 EXPEDITED TIMEFRAMES

Added SRHUD Subsidized Rental Housing Utility Deposit as an expedited application type and outlined the season and timeframe for processing timely.

Updated the crisis application acceptance dates and timeframes for processing timely.

MS 3008-1 TIME FRAMES FOR ASSISTANCE PAYMENTS

Updated the timeframe for acceptance and processing of SRHUD Subsidized Rental Housing Utility Deposit and crisis applications.

MS 3008-2 USE OF HAP PAYMENTS

Revised section for clarity.

Removed option to purchase propane when propane is not the primary home heating fuel or primary fuel used for power consumption.

Removed note requiring caseworkers to contact the local electric company to confirm a client lives off-grid. Client statement is acceptable.

Removed reference to types of oil and gasoline a vendor is allowed to let a household purchase when their primary heating fuel is self-harvested wood. Self-harvest wood households no longer have their benefit issued to a vendor; they receive direct payment.

MS 3008-4 METHODS OF PAYMENT

Removed reference to wood prices when shopping for the best deal through an approved vendor, as households who use wood as their primary heating fuel are not required to use an approved vendor and are issued a direct payment.

ADDENDUM A COMMUNITY LISTING

Updated Community Listying for FFY Federal Fiscal Year 2026.

ADDENDUM B HAP TRIBAL PROVIDERS

Updated Tribal Provider information for FFY Federal Fiscal Year 2026.

ADDENDUM E INCOME GUIDELINES

Updated the Federal Poverty Income Guidelines for FFY Federal Fiscal Year 2026.

ADDENDUM G INCOME GRID

Updated addendum title from "Income Grid" to "Countable and Excluded Income for HAP Heating Assistance Program " to align with DPA's other program manuals.

Department of Health

Division of Public Assistance

TRANSMITTAL NUMBER: 2025-03

MANUAL: Heating Assistance Program

DATE: December 1, 2025

Several sections of the Heating Assistance Program Policy Manual have been revised in order to incorporate new policy, clarify existing policy, and align policies within our division's policy manuals.

If you have questions, please contact the Policy & Program Development Team at hss.dpa.policy@alaska.gov.

OVERVIEW OF CHANGES

MS 3000-2 DEFINITIONS

Removed Adult Public Assistance (APA) from the "mixed household" definition, as receipt of APA does not qualify a household as categorically eligible. This change prevents misinterpretation and aligns the manual with federal LIHEAP Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program guidance.

Removed "Public Assistance Household" definition as it is an obsolete term, which was specific to the previous eligibility system and is not applicable within ECOS Energy Community Online System .

3001-4 VERIFICATIONS

Updated the name of the child support payment system from WinStar to ACSESS Alaska Child Support Enforcement Services System .

ADDENDUM G COUNTABLE AND EXCLUDED INCOME FOR HAP

Added Census income to align with DPA manuals.

Added clarity to Educational Income rows (Title IV and Non-Title IV.)

STATE OF ALASKA

Department of Health

Division of Public Assistance

TRANSMITTAL NUMBER: 2026-01

MANUAL: Heating Assistance Program

DATE: April 1, 2026

Several sections of the Heating Assistance Program Policy Manual have been revised in order to incorporate new policy, clarify existing policy, and align policies within our division's policy manuals.

If you have questions, please contact the Policy & Program Development Team at hss.dpa.policy@alaska.gov.

OVERVIEW OF CHANGES

MS 3001-5 DEFINITIONS

Revised the "Energy Bill Credit Exceeds Maximum Allowed" reason for clarity.

MS 3002-1 TYPES OF HOUSEHOLDS

Updated categorical eligibility criteria to include households participating in ATAP. Alaska Temporary Assistance Program

MS 3003-4 INCOME FROM SELF-EMPLOYMENT

Updated the Self-Employment Annualization Standards used in examples to align with FY Fiscal Year 2026 calculations.

MS 3004-5 GRANT COMPUTATION

Updated income amounts used in grant computation examples to reflect Federal Poverty Level (FPL) guidelines used for FY Fiscal Year 2026.

MS 3008-3 DISTRIBUTION OF GRANT BETWEEN HEATING AND ELECTRICITY

Clarified that the heating/electric benefit split is a fixed 50/50 option only; partial or discretionary splits are not allowed. Exceptions apply only when issuing more than 50% to electricity to restore or prevent disconnection.
